CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 9, 2018 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF HELLER'S BARBERS - It is recommended the City Council present Florica Heller of Heller's Barbers with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.1 Recognition of Heller's Barbers
6.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Leticia Revilla for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
6.2 Recognition of Employee for Years of Service
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE SENIOR COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council appoint Aracely Ruiz to the La Mirada Senior Council for a term expiring in June 2019.
7.1 Appointment to Senior Council
7.2
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint John Grotz to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term expiring in May 2019.
7.2 Reappointment to the La Mirada Community Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of September 25, 2018.
8.1 Minutes of September 25, 2018
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 9, 2018 in the total amount of $2,011,827.77.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2018 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 2018.
8.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-14, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Dynalectric; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
8.4 CIP No. 2015-14
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-03, LEFFINGWELL ROAD STREET REHABILITATION FROM TELEGRAPH ROAD TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2015-03, Leffingwell Road Street Rehabilitation from Telegraph Road to La Mirada Boulevard, to R.J. Noble Company in the amount of $1,088,533.19; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, and construction survey, testing and inspection.
8.5 CIP No. 2015-03
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 18-26 APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA NATURAL RESOURCES AGENCY DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION – OFFICE OF GRANTS AND LOCAL SERVICES FOR THE REHABILITATION OF THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-26 approving the application for grant funds from the State of California Natural Resources Agency Department of Parks and Recreation – Office of Grants and Local Services for the rehabilitation of the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
9.1 Resolution No. 18-26
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 18-27 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS SOUND SYSTEM DESIGN ENHANCEMENT AND INSTALLATION AND GRANT FUNDS FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA NATURAL RESOURCES AGENCY DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Theatre sound design enhancement and installation to Diversified in the amount of $423,571.49; authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement with Diversified on behalf of the City; and adopt Resolution No. 18-27 authorizing a budget amendment for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts sound system design enhancement and installation and grant funds from the State of California Natural Resources Agency Department of Parks and Recreation.
9.2 Resolution No. 18-27
